info.name: LMS — Books (v1)
info.description:
Student/teacher app APIs for class books (PDF library).

**Scoping (automatic, by role):**
- **Student** → books for their class (standard) + section (or section-less books for the class).
- **Teacher** → books for the (class, subject) pairs they teach **via the timetable**.

Auth: Sanctum bearer token in `authToken`.

request.description: Paginated list of active books, auto-scoped to the caller's class/subjects. Each item: id, title, logo_url, standard, section, subject. Optional filters: standard_id, section_id, subject_id, search.
Single book (role-scoped) including `pdf_url` for reading/downloading. 404 if the book is outside the caller's scope.
